name: Cheesy Portobello Mushroom Burger with Blueberry BBQ Sauce & Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 (170 g) pkg blueberries
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the lemons into a blender. (Reserve remaining lemons for the dressing.)
Peel garlic; add to the blender along with blueberries, ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, and spices. Blend on high until very smooth, 1-2 minutes. Set BBQ sauce aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup ketchup
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp soy sauce
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; place on a large plate.
Peel and slice onions crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings; add to the plate with the mushrooms. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches, add the veggies and grill, undisturbed, until tender and lightly charred on one side, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve plate for later use.)
While the veggies are grilling, thinly slice cheese.

When the veggies are charred on one side, flip, then top each mushroom with cheese; continue to grill until veggies are tender and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lemons into a large bowl; add oil, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp parsley flakes
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl along with mixed greens and almonds; toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Spread half of the BBQ sauce over the bottom half of each bun; layer with mushrooms, onions, and remaining sauce. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
